unit.why: A single narrative, quoted from Agra de-Pirka, about the Maggid R. Dov Ber in his poverty: he hears a heavenly voice say he has lost his share in the World to Come, resolves to serve God without reward, and is restored.

stories.start_quote: בספר אגרא דפרקא אות ב׳ וזה"ל
stories.end_quote: אין לך רחמנות מרובה מרחמנותו ית"ש עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: While the Maggid R. Dov Ber lived secluded in poverty, his wife wept over their starving children and he sighed. A heavenly voice declared he had lost his share in the World to Come. Trembling, he resolved to serve God purely, without hope of reward, and returned to his study. Heaven then restored his share, warning him never again to sigh out of pity for his children, since God's mercy exceeds all.

quotes: פ"א באתה אשתו והתחילה לספר לו בבכיה
מגודל דחקות בניה איך הם רעבים וצמאים
tags.why: His wife and starving children are part of the scene.

quotes: פ"א באתה אשתו והתחילה לספר לו בבכיה
tags.why: The wife's weeping complaint triggers the sigh and the heavenly decree.

quotes: הוא ובניו מדוכים בחיצי רעב עד מאד
tags.why: The tsaddik lives in poverty as part of his secluded devotion.
He was living in seclusion (hitbodedut) at the time.

quotes: שמע קול שאמרו לו מן השמים
אז בשרוהו מהשמים אשר החזירוהו לחיי עוה״ב
tags.why: A voice from heaven speaks to him twice.

quotes: שמע קול שאמרו לו מן השמים שכבר אבד חלקו מן עוה״ב
tags.why: A heavenly disclosure is made to him.

quotes: והנה עמד מרעיד כרגע בהתבוננו בדעתו
tags.why: He trembles at the heavenly decree.
Loss of his share in the World to Come is the punishment for his sigh.

quotes: יהי׳ נזהר שלא יעשה כזאת היינו שלא יתאנח עוד
tags.why: Heaven forbids him to sigh again.
His share in the World to Come is the central issue.
His Torah study is interrupted and then resumed.

quotes: אהי׳ עובד עבודה אמתיות שכבר אבד סברו משני העולמות
tags.why: The point is service of God without hope of reward.
The tale illustrates the Maggid's pure, disinterested devotion.

quotes: ותהי' עבודתו באמת רק לעשות נחת רוח
tags.why: His resolve reflects religious awe and pure service of God.

quotes: סיפרו לי מעשה רב מאת כ״ק הרה״ק
tags.why: The tale is framed as told to the author of Agra de-Pirka.

missing_concepts: serving God without expectation of reward (lishmah)
trust in God / divine mercy over human compassion
